disputed_verses.KJV NEH 12:35: And certain of the priests' sons with trumpets; namely, Zechariah the son of Jonathan, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Michaiah, the son of Zaccur, the son of Asaph:

first_reader_said: NEH 12:35: Both records are Shemaiah ben Mattaniah, father of Jonathan, at the same point of the pedigree in 12:35.

why: NEH 12:35 identifies Shemaiah as Mattaniah’s son and Jonathan’s father, so both records claim the same genealogical occurrence. EZR 8:16 supplies no parentage connecting its Shemaiah with that ancestor, and A’s link to the Mattaniah of 2CH 29:13 is not established by either supplied verse. The shared occurrence exposes overlapping attribution but does not establish whether Ezra’s envoy and Zechariah’s grandfather were one man or two.
